fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

When a user signed up for the league while authenticated via Discord, their Discord ID was not being associated with their Magic Online username/person record. The `retire_deck()` flow already called `ps.associate()` (line 95), but `add_signup()` did not.

## What changed

In `decksite/controllers/league.py`, added two lines to `add_signup()` after `d = lg.signup(form)` to call `ps.associate(d, session['id'])` when a Discord session is active. This exactly mirrors the existing pattern in `retire_deck()`. The `associate()` function is safe to call unconditionally because it only writes when `discord_id IS NULL`, preventing overwrites of existing associations.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected

Fixes #11991
fix.pr_title: Associate Discord ID with person on league signup (#11991)

evidence.detail: retire flow calls ps.associate(d, session['id']) to link Discord ID to MTGO username after retiring
add_signup() calls lg.signup(form) and redirects but never calls ps.associate — no Discord association happens at signup time even when session['id'] is set
associate() runs `UPDATE person SET discord_id = %s WHERE id = (SELECT person_id FROM deck WHERE id = %s) AND discord_id IS NULL` — safe: only sets if not already associated
league controller imports both `from flask import ... session` and `from decksite.data import person as ps` — all needed pieces are already in scope
